name: Thermal circuit breaker
summary: A thermal circuit breaker uses a temperature-responsive trip mechanism to detect sustained overload.
description: A thermal circuit breaker uses a temperature-responsive trip mechanism to detect sustained overload. Thermal operation and short-circuit interruption capability are separate aspects of the selected device.
readingNotes: Look for the overload characteristic and ambient-temperature conditions in the equipment schedule.
The preview is an original explanation of this function. Match the actual drawing convention to its legend and the selected equipment documentation.
distinction: Thermal tripping does not imply the same instantaneous response as magnetic tripping.
